title: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Princess of Kroog, widow of Urza and ruler of Penregon five years after the cataclysm; she mourns her son Harbin and decides to defend her city.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's former assistant, an aged and frostbitten artificer who returns to Penregon with Urza's designs and powerstones and builds civil automatons.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Kayla's husband and the artificer whose war with his brother ended the world; Tawnos reveals he is not dead but has become something else.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, who attacked Kroog and whose war with Urza burned the world down.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Kayla and Urza's son, a pilot who died in the war.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: Kayla's young child, who is in study with tutors.

entities.name: Myrel
entities.description: Penregon's scout captain, who reports on the Talite march and prepares the defense.

entities.name: Raddic of Kroog
entities.description: A scarred veteran and leader of the Talite crusade against machines, who gives Penregon until dawn to drive out its machines.

entities.name: Arah
entities.description: A man in a brass cap whom Raddic met in the trenches, who is among his emissaries.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: An artificer who worked for Mishra and made transmogrants.

entities.name: Tal
entities.description: An old god of Yotia associated with the sun, whom Raddic and the Talites worship.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: The coastal city of remains that Kayla rules, where it now snows.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Kayla's birthplace, sacked by Mishra and now a ruin.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: A city that the Talites claim to have liberated from a machine warlord.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: A once-verdant island southeast of Penregon, now reduced to basalt spires.

entities.name: Iron Tower
entities.description: Urza's old tower hidden in mist-shrouded mountains, the Talites' destination.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent on which Penregon lies, devastated by the war.

entities.name: Kher Ridges
entities.description: The misty mountain range near Penregon.

entities.name: Talites
entities.description: A huge crusading march of the faithful of Tal, led by Raddic, who seek to cleanse the land of machines.

entities.name: Civils
entities.description: Tawnos's civil automatons that haul stone for Penregon's wall and can be repurposed to wield weapons.

entities.name: Powerstones
entities.description: Stones that power machines; Tawnos has recovered a clutch and knows where Argive's buried stockpile lies.

entities.name: The Cataclysm
entities.description: The blast that ended the brothers' war, bringing earthquakes and tidal waves.

entities.name: Transmogrants
entities.description: Ashnod's creations carried in cages or bound with wire by the marchers.

events.summary: Five years after the cataclysm, Kayla sits alone in Penregon's council chambers reviewing grim grain reports and an empty map of the Visceral Sea.
events.quote: Kayla bin-Kroog sat alone in the council chambers of Penregon's government house

events.summary: Tawnos, frostbitten and aged, arrives for a private meeting and Kayla tells him she thought he was dead.
events.quote: I thought you were dead.

events.summary: Tawnos says Urza stopped a demon from taking the world after his brother was turned and fused with a machine.
events.quote: Turned by that creature. Fused with a machine.

events.summary: Kayla confronts Tawnos about the death of her son Harbin and says she will never forgive him.
events.quote: I will never forgive you for convincing me to allow my son to go off and die in my husband's war.

events.summary: Tawnos shows Urza's and his own designs, says he recovered powerstones and knows where Argive's buried stockpile lies, and offers to build tools to rebuild Penregon.
events.quote: I was able to recover a clutch of powerstones and know where we can find more.

events.summary: Kayla refuses to remember Urza as he wished and says she is glad he is gone.
events.quote: I will remember him as he was.

events.summary: Tawnos reveals that Urza is not dead but has become something else.
events.quote: Urza is not dead, ma'am.

events.summary: Kayla sends Tawnos to Urza's old factories with Myrel so he can begin building.
events.quote: Tomorrow, I will have Myrel, my scout captain, take you to the warehouses so you can begin.

events.summary: Months later Myrel reports a ten-thousand-strong ragged march approaching, flying black banners and carrying machine remains and Ashnod's transmogrants; Tawnos says his civils can be armed.
events.quote: My best assumption is ten thousand

events.summary: The vast march arrives outside Penregon, and five black-clad emissaries ride toward the gates.
events.quote: They pointed toward a small clutch of black-clad riders that had broken away and begun riding for Penregon's gates.

events.summary: Kayla offers the emissaries entry on three conditions, and Raddic announces a crusade of penitents against machines.
events.quote: We are the living of Terisiare, who seek to clean this land of machine filth.

events.summary: Raddic says the crusade is bound for the Iron Tower, and Kayla describes where it is hidden.
events.quote: It is well hidden in the mountains somewhere to the west or southwest.

events.summary: Kayla declines to join the crusade but allows refugees into the city with no weapons or soldiers.
events.quote: Your people are free to seek refuge in our city, but we ask that no soldiers enter.

events.summary: Talites in the market attack one of Tawnos's civils; two pilgrims die in the guards' response, a guard is wounded and the rest are arrested.
events.quote: Two of the pilgrims are dead and one of our guards was wounded.

events.summary: Myrel reports the marchers arming and Raddic approaching the gates, and Kayla refuses to hide.
events.quote: This is my city, captain. I will not hide when Penregon is threatened.

events.summary: Kayla orders Tawnos to arm the civils and Myrel to levy the militia.
events.quote: Tawnos, arm the civils,

events.summary: Kayla remembers fleeing the fall of Kroog while pregnant.
events.quote: She fled the city, pregnant with her son.

events.summary: Raddic accuses Penregon of harboring machine demons and reveals that Talites living in the city told him of Tawnos and the civils.
events.quote: Many of the faithful arrived here years ago

events.summary: Raddic gives Penregon an ultimatum to drive out the machines and tear down the tower by dawn, and throws a spear at Kayla's feet.
events.quote: Choose: die with it or live with us!

events.summary: Kayla tells Myrel to save the archers' arrows for the next day.
events.quote: Save our arrows,

relations.quote: You were always close with my husband.

relations.note: Harbin is Kayla's son, killed in the war.
relations.quote: All Harbin ever wanted to do was make his father proud

relations.note: Rule of Penregon fell to Kayla after the cataclysm.
relations.quote: rule of the city fell to her.
The man's voice was clear and sturdy, a leader's voice

relations.note: Ashnod was an artificer who worked for Mishra.
relations.quote: Some artificer who worked for Mishra during the war

relations.note: The Talites attack a civil, calling it a demon.
The brothers' war burned the world.
relations.quote: They burned the world down because neither of them could talk to one another.
